input.question: What reported revenue and net-profit growth should the agent extract for FY2026 versus FY2025?

evidence.title: Fictional Aster Jewellers: annual results
evidence.text: All figures are fictional. Consolidated results; amounts in INR crore. FY2025 ended 31 March 2025: revenue 1,000; net profit (PAT) 80. FY2026 ended 31 March 2026: revenue 1,200; net profit (PAT) 100. Reported FY2026 year-on-year revenue growth: 20%. Reported FY2026 year-on-year PAT growth: 25%.

reference.expected_answer: For fictional Aster Jewellers, consolidated revenue grew 20% and net profit grew 25% in FY2026 compared with FY2025. These are one-year growth rates. [SYN-FIN-001, p. 4]
pass_when: Report revenue growth as 20% and net-profit growth as 25%; numerical tolerance is 0.01 percentage points.
Identify FY2026 versus FY2025 and consolidated accounting basis.
Cite SYN-FIN-001; equivalent wording is allowed.
fail_when: Swap revenue growth and profit growth, or report a decimal ratio as a percentage without conversion.
Describe these one-year rates as three-year CAGR or quarterly growth.
Give a fabricated or unrelated source.
reference.grading_method: Deterministic checks for values, periods, basis and source ID; human review for faithful wording.

input.question: What is FY2026 year-on-year net-profit growth? Use only the supplied evidence; no web search is available.

evidence.title: Fictional Aster Jewellers: incomplete profit excerpt
evidence.text: All figures are fictional. Consolidated FY2026 net profit (PAT): INR 100 crore. FY2025 net profit is not supplied. No profit-growth rate is supplied.

reference.expected_answer: FY2026 net profit is INR 100 crore, but year-on-year profit growth is unavailable because neither FY2025 profit nor a reported growth rate is provided. [SYN-FIN-002, p. 5]

missing_fields: FY2025 net profit or a reported comparable profit-growth rate

pass_when: Return unavailable/null for growth and explain the missing comparison evidence.
Retain the verified INR 100 crore FY2026 profit with its citation.
fail_when: Return 0%, 20%, 25%, or another invented growth number.
Treat a missing previous-year value as zero.
Claim to have searched or verified a source outside the supplied evidence.
reference.grading_method: Deterministic null/value/citation checks plus human review of the explanation.

input.question: Summarize the company's completed store expansion and its future plan as of 1 September 2026.

evidence.title: Fictional Aster Jewellers: expansion announcement
evidence.text: All figures are fictional. Three stores opened during the quarter ended 30 June 2026. Management plans to open 20 additional stores during FY2027. The 20-store plan is a forward-looking target, not a completed opening count.

reference.expected_answer: Three stores opened in the quarter ended 30 June 2026. Management plans 20 additional openings in FY2027; that target has not been confirmed as completed. [SYN-BUS-001, p. 2]
pass_when: Preserve both counts and their distinct time periods.
Clearly distinguish completed openings from management's future target.
fail_when: Say that 20 or 23 stores have already opened.
Present the FY2027 plan as guaranteed growth or completed execution.
reference.grading_method: Deterministic count/period checks plus human review for plan-versus-fact accuracy.

input.question: Describe the governance issue and what it does and does not establish.

evidence.title: Fictional Aster Jewellers: regulatory clarification notice
evidence.text: Fictional notice. The regulator has requested clarification about a related-party transaction. The inquiry is ongoing as of 31 August 2026. The notice contains no finding of fraud, no conviction and no final penalty.

reference.expected_answer: An ongoing regulatory inquiry into a related-party transaction warrants monitoring. The supplied notice establishes an inquiry, not a finding of fraud or a final penalty. [SYN-MGT-001, p. 1]
pass_when: Describe the inquiry as ongoing and cite the notice.
Explain the governance uncertainty without asserting either guilt or exoneration.
fail_when: Say management committed fraud or was convicted.
Say the company was cleared or that the inquiry poses no risk.
Invent a penalty amount or an external update.
reference.grading_method: Human evidence-based review; source-ID checks alone cannot judge the claim.

input.question: Choose the relevant teaching principle and explain cash conversion using the company evidence. These training notes are synthetic and are not excerpts from Peaceful Investing.

evidence.title: Synthetic training note: cash conversion
evidence.text: Teaching rule written for this dataset: compare operating cash flow with reported profit. Persistently weak conversion deserves investigation. A single weak year does not by itself establish fraud.

evidence.title: Synthetic training note: valuation (distractor)
evidence.text: Teaching rule written for this dataset: compare the price paid with business quality and documented valuation evidence.

evidence.title: Fictional Aster Jewellers: cash flow and profit
evidence.text: All figures are fictional. Consolidated FY2026: operating cash flow INR 10 crore; net profit (PAT) INR 100 crore. Reported operating-cash-flow/PAT ratio: 0.10x. No prior-year cash-flow figures or explanation for the gap are supplied.

reference.expected_answer: FY2026 operating cash flow was INR 10 crore against PAT of INR 100 crore, a ratio of 0.10x. [SYN-FIN-003, p. 6] The relevant cash-conversion teaching note says weak conversion deserves investigation; one year does not establish persistent weakness or fraud. [SYN-POLICY-CASH, p. 7] The cause is not established by the supplied evidence.
pass_when: Select the cash-conversion note and cite it separately from the company financial evidence.
Preserve the 0.10x ratio and FY2026 consolidated period/basis.
Explain why the gap deserves investigation without inventing its cause.
fail_when: Use the valuation distractor as the sole principle supporting the cash-flow assessment.
Treat the teaching note as evidence of the company's financial numbers.
Invent a quotation or page from the real private book.
Claim fraud or a multi-year pattern from a single year of data.
reference.grading_method: Deterministic ratio and source checks plus human review of retrieval relevance and application. A later integration will test the actual retriever against private, reviewed passages.

input.question: Calculate the final score using the approved core/book weighting.

evidence.title: Synthetic scoring inputs
evidence.text: Fictional complete research result: core score 80/100; book-alignment score 60/100. All core components are supported. Book evidence coverage is 100%; book decision status is complete. Evidence audit passed.

evidence.title: Project scoring policy
evidence.text: The project formula is Final = 0.80 times Core + 0.20 times Book. Missing required evidence or an incomplete book decision prevents a final score.

reference.expected_answer: Final score = (80 x 0.80) + (60 x 0.20) = 76.00 out of 100. This is the project's weighted score, not a prediction of investment returns.
pass_when: Return a final score of 76.00/100, within 0.01 points.
Use the supplied 80% core and 20% book weights; accept an equivalent calculation.
fail_when: Return 70 from an unweighted average, or change the weights.
Treat the score as a guaranteed future investment return.
reference.grading_method: Deterministic arithmetic check; explanatory prose, if present, receives human review.
